## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, expected result and what changes.

## Validation

List the commands/checks actually run, backend and hardware. Include skipped checks and limitations. For geometry changes, attach a small fixture and relevant invariants; for performance work, include transfers and the CPU reference.

## Compatibility

Note any changes to component GUIDs, I/O, tree paths, numeric semantics, public APIs, serialized definitions or dependencies.
